procedures_covered: Cervical disc arthroplasty single level, simultaneous second contiguous level, subsequent adjacent level

logic.top_level: all (6 numbered criteria); variants by reference
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Investigational list for 'ALL other indications', which merges anatomical/clinical contraindications with several extras: neck or arm pain of unknown etiology; absence of neck/arm pain; progressive neurological deficit or deterioration; Paget's disease; radiological evidence of instability (> 3.5 mm subluxation or > 11 degrees angulation); spinal metastases; non-FDA-approved prosthesis.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Subsequent adjacent-level: 4-item AND list; revision/replacement codes 22861 and 0098T listed as investigational.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: which has failed at least 6 weeks ... AND physical therapy; OR b. if the patient has severe or rapidly progressive symptoms ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Criterion 3 is a one-of-two inside an all-of; 'pharmacotherapy ... AND physical therapy' joins within 3a.
Listed as investigational here, yet 3b admits 'severe or rapidly progressive symptoms of nerve root or spinal cord compression' as a qualifying route; internal tension.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Cervical degenerative disc disease is from C3-C7; AND 6. The patient is free from contraindication
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Stray 'AND' after item 5 and semicolon; lists mixed.

Degeneration is documented by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), OR myelography

Clinical documentation that the initial cervical disc arthroplasty is fully healed
